You Belong at CSI! Imagine earning a world-class education on a beautiful campus, in the world’s most exciting city. A world of exciting opportunity awaits you at CSI, including our magnificent campus, exciting student life, outstanding academics, new high-end apartment-style living and a dedicated, knowledgeable faculty. We’re the right choice if you are: An undergraduate looking for a quality two-year or four-year college experience An exceptional student looking for an affordable honors program A graduate school candidate hoping to earn your advanced certificate, master’s or doctorate degree A few reasons why you should consider CSI: We focus on hands-on research and scholarship. Compared to many other research institutions, undergraduate students perform research with faculty and have access to state-of-the-art equipment and facilities at a much earlier point in their academic career. We provide international educational opportunities through our Center for Global Engagement. Our 204-acre campus is the largest single site for a New York City college. Set in a park-like landscape, CSI offers a traditional campus setting in close proximity to New York City. Our tuition rates are one of the lowest in the country for New York State residents, while remaining very reasonable for out-of-state students. Luxury Dormitories: Dolphin Cove Student Housing Luxury residence halls, Dolphin Cove, have increased the College’s national and international desirability. More than 400 students can now live on campus in private bedrooms, with shared living space, study rooms, and laundry facilities. We offer these configurations: 4 bedrooms/2 bath, 3 bedrooms/2 bath, and 2 bedrooms/1 bath. Learn More About CSI Want to learn even more? Here are some great facts about CSI: Named a Top Public College in the Northeast by US News and World Report ! Close proximity to New York City with a quick ferry ride to downtown Manhattan. Our tuition rates remain one of the lowest in the country for NYS residents and very reasonable for out-of-state students. As the only public college on Staten Island, we offer a program for everyone, from associate's degrees to doctoral programs. Our knowledgeable Recruitment and Admission staff are available to answer all your questions and facilitate your enrollment at CSI any way we can. We encourage you to come visit our campus in person and meet with an admissions advisor.
